_about: 2006-census side (c1) of the 2004 people-interpolation lane. A booth's demo block is the 2006 Basic Community Profile counts of the 2006-census collection district its premises sit in (data/booth-seifa-2004.json's coordinates, point-in-polygon against the ABS 1259.0.30.002 CD-2006 shapes) — the venue's neighbourhood, never the booth's voters; a division's row is the exact 2006-BCP sum over the CDs whole-allocated to the 2003-edition division set (seifa-src/cd-2006-ced-2003ed.json). Booth rows without carried coordinates, or whose coordinates fall outside every 2006 CD polygon, carry demo:null (counts.boothsPipMiss), as does one whose CD housed no one (boothsPipEmpty). Shares mirror the 2006-era store's recipes verbatim (derive-booth-demo-2006.py's load_bcp + shares via importlib, the income lanes riding the same B26/B28 engine). The two sides blend to election day at the SEIFA pcti lane's day-share — see data/booth-demo-2004.json's demoInterp record; this store is the far side only.

sourceUrls.bcp: ABS 2006 Census Basic Community Profile, CD for AUS per state (abs.gov.au archive Census 2006 downloads, census06bcp.zip)
sourceUrls.shapes: ABS 1259.0.30.002 CD for AUS per state (ASGC 2006, 1259030002_cd06a{st}_shape.zip)

deliveryBasis: venue-proxy per booth (2006-census CD of the premises, point-in-polygon); exact 2006-BCP CD sum per division (cd-2006-ced-2003ed)
